content:
{a}True you ride the finest horse {F}I've ever seen, 
{G}standing sixteen, one or two, with so {a}eyes wild and green.
And you ride the horse so well, {F}hands light to the touch.
{G}I could never go with you no matter how I {a}wanted to.

|:Ride on, see {F}you.
{G}I could never go with you no matter how I wanted {a}to :|

When you ride into the night without a trace behind, 
run your claw along my gut, one last time. 
I turn to face an empty space, where you used to lie 
and look for the spark that lights the night through a teardrop in my eye.

Letzte wie erste
title: Ride on
